units.source_text: 本当‘暗藏相思情’，但终于‘欲抑不能抑’了！”

en.t: It was truly a case of secretly hiding feelings of love, but at last they could no longer be suppressed!

units.source_text: 信上写的似乎只此数字而已。

en.t: It seemed that these few words were all that was written in the letter.

units.source_text: 明石道人悄悄地等候着源氏公子的消息，

en.t: The Akashi Novice had been quietly waiting for news from Lord Genji,

units.source_text: 走到山边的内宅里来一看，

en.t: and when he went to look in the inner residence by the mountain,

units.source_text: 果然送信的使者来了。

en.t: sure enough, the messenger bearing the letter had arrived.

units.source_text: 他就竭诚招待，殷勤劝酒，

en.t: He welcomed him with the utmost sincerity and pressed wine on him attentively,

units.source_text: 灌得他面孔通红。

en.t: until he had made the man's face turn bright red.

units.source_text: 但小姐的回信只管不送出来。

en.t: But the young lady's reply still would not be sent out.

units.source_text: 明石道人便走进女儿房间里，催她快写。

en.t: The Akashi Novice then went into his daughter's room and urged her to write quickly.

units.source_text: 女儿还是不听。

en.t: His daughter still would not listen.

units.source_text: 她看见了这封教人受之有愧的情书，

en.t: When she saw this love letter, one that made her feel unworthy even to receive it,

units.source_text: 羞耻得手也伸不出来。

en.t: she was so ashamed that she could not even reach out her hand.

units.source_text: 她拿对方的身份和自己的身份比较一下，

en.t: She compared his rank with her own,

units.source_text: 觉得相去太远，不敢高攀。

en.t: and felt that the distance between them was far too great for her to aspire so high.

units.source_text: 便推说“心绪不好”，横靠着躺下了。

en.t: So she made the excuse that she was feeling unsettled, then leaned sideways and lay down.

units.source_text: 明石道人无可奈何，只得代她写回信：

en.t: The Akashi Novice had no choice but to write the reply on her behalf:

units.source_text: “承赐华函，不胜感激。

en.t: I am deeply grateful to have received your gracious letter.

units.source_text: 惟小女生长蓬门，少见世面，

en.t: However, my daughter was raised in a humble household and has seen little of the world,

units.source_text: 想是‘今宵大喜袖难容’之故吧，

en.t: so perhaps it is because tonight's great joy is more than her sleeves can contain,

units.source_text: 竟惶恐得不能拜读来书。

en.t: that she has become so overwhelmed with awe that she cannot even read your letter.

units.source_text: 朽人猜度其心，正是：

en.t: In this old man's guess, her heart is just as the following words say:
